limitations: Real native MID/ROW getters, menu-open routing, create_screen dispatch/map initialization and custom text bridge run offline. Lowest-level widget allocation and UX drawing remain fixtures; physical font/LCD geometry/occlusion, transparency and GUI event timing await camera acceptance.

Movement applies and durably saves on the worker, retaining the page; confirm/back verifies the committed descriptor through the original resource resolver, then native pop reconstructs and updates the parent. It never dereferences the destroyed parent presenter. CP ACK/E4 execution and the resolver are control-plane witnesses, without LCD/ISP frame completion evidence.
UI wait yields up to20 seconds. An overlong native Fsys call may exceed deadlines; page keeps the exact pending transaction and a later UI event resolves it.
Failed commit keeps the page; parent display refresh failures use a separate status. Best-effort rollback may fail; no hardware rollback guarantee.
OSAL same-destination FIFO and downstream native parameter application completion are not independently established.
CP grid/parameter consumers inherited exactly from frozen4.23 with4.22 lifecycle.
Wheel burst checks replay individual canonical native events; each event means one step. No hardware detent rate, payload step-count protocol or physical preview frame is inferred.
Runs execute original ARM64 migration policy with modeled valid property/header services and memcpy, not complete Backup parsing, updater, VFS or device hardware.
Native parser/checksum verification of all real generated templates is independent of the modeled migration helper boundary.
Actual selected UUD/Backup mode on the user camera is not observed; already-enabled LOOK preservation is demonstrated for reviewed mode5 only.
No personal settings/restore image is generated, embedded, written or reused.
Install, readback, eMMC/physical-NOR consistency and final camera behaviour need separate device acceptance.
R6 native BK4 layout is not independently authenticated; recovered values are converted to R5 format.
Only ST photo bank0 is changed; ST movie profile21 maps to bank1 and is unchanged.
Original scene/alias profiles that already map to bank0 naturally share its updated coefficients; profile mappings are not changed.
Gamma first128 and effective short fields equal R5; missing Gamma point129 is not fabricated.
Firmware migration must be packaged and independently checked; this module alone does not update a camera.
Synthetic zero-filled caller contexts and supplied calibration1024 are not live camera memory.
Normal native profiles tested; scenes/aliases already mapped to bank0 share its change.
AWB state gate/statistics branches have no asserted photo/video semantics; results are internal coordinates, not RGB/JPEG quality.
Native upgrade migration and final firmware package are verified separately by the preservation and root stages.
